018package org.apache.hadoop.hbase.backup;
019
020import static org.apache.hadoop.hbase.backup.BackupRestoreConstants.CONTINUOUS_BACKUP_REPLICATION_PEER;
021import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
022import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;
023
024import java.io.IOException;
025import org.apache.hadoop.conf.Configuration;
026import org.apache.hadoop.fs.FileSystem;
027import org.apache.hadoop.fs.FilterFileSystem;
028import org.apache.hadoop.fs.Path;
029import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.HBaseTestingUtil;
030import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.TableName;
031import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.backup.impl.BackupAdminImpl;
032import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.backup.impl.BackupManager;
033import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.client.Admin;
034import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.client.Connection;
035import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.client.ConnectionFactory;
036import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.replication.ReplicationPeerDescription;
037import org.apache.hadoop.hdfs.DistributedFileSystem;
038import org.apache.yetus.audience.InterfaceAudience;
039
040@InterfaceAudience.Private
041public class BackupTestUtil {
042  private BackupTestUtil() {
043  }
044
045  static BackupInfo verifyBackup(Configuration conf, String backupId, BackupType expectedType,
046    BackupInfo.BackupState expectedState) throws IOException {
047    try (Connection connection = ConnectionFactory.createConnection(conf);
048      BackupAdmin backupAdmin = new BackupAdminImpl(connection)) {
049      BackupInfo backupInfo = backupAdmin.getBackupInfo(backupId);
050
051      // Verify managed backup in HBase
052      assertEquals(backupId, backupInfo.getBackupId());
053      assertEquals(expectedState, backupInfo.getState());
054      assertEquals(expectedType, backupInfo.getType());
055      return backupInfo;
056    }
057  }
058
059  public static void enableBackup(Configuration conf) {
060    conf.setBoolean(BackupRestoreConstants.BACKUP_ENABLE_KEY, true);
061    BackupManager.decorateMasterConfiguration(conf);
062    BackupManager.decorateRegionServerConfiguration(conf);
063  }
064
065  public static void verifyReplicationPeerSubscription(HBaseTestingUtil util, TableName tableName)
066    throws IOException {
067    try (Admin admin = util.getAdmin()) {
068      ReplicationPeerDescription peerDesc = admin.listReplicationPeers().stream()
069        .filter(peer -> peer.getPeerId().equals(CONTINUOUS_BACKUP_REPLICATION_PEER)).findFirst()
070        .orElseThrow(() -> new AssertionError("Replication peer not found"));
071
072      assertTrue(peerDesc.getPeerConfig().getTableCFsMap().containsKey(tableName),
073        "Table should be subscribed to the replication peer");
074    }
075  }
076
077  /**
078   * Returns a copy of the given configuration whose HDFS file system implementation is
079   * {@link MarkerDeletionFailHDFS}, with file system caching disabled so the override takes effect.
080   */
081  static Configuration createMarkerDeletionFailConf(Configuration base) {
082    Configuration conf = new Configuration(base);
083    conf.setClass("fs.hdfs.impl", MarkerDeletionFailHDFS.class, FileSystem.class);
084    conf.setBoolean("fs.hdfs.impl.disable.cache", true);
085    return conf;
086  }
087
088  /**
089   * A {@link DistributedFileSystem} wrapper that refuses to delete the backup completion marker
090   * file ({@link HBackupFileSystem#BACKUP_COMPLETE_FILE_NAME}).
091   */
092  public static class MarkerDeletionFailHDFS extends FilterFileSystem {
093    public MarkerDeletionFailHDFS() {
094      super(new DistributedFileSystem());
095    }
096
097    @Override
098    public boolean delete(Path f, boolean recursive) throws IOException {
099      if (f.getName().equals(HBackupFileSystem.BACKUP_COMPLETE_FILE_NAME)) {
100        return false;
101      }
102      return super.delete(f, recursive);
103    }
104  }
105}
